office_does: A Spokane County District Court judge hears misdemeanor and gross-misdemeanor criminal cases and traffic infractions, sets bail and holds preliminary hearings; all judges are elected countywide.
race_blurb: Uncontested: incumbent Judge Aimee N. Maurer is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Spokane County District Court judge for about 12 years and former presiding judge; the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: About 12 years on the District Court bench, including as presiding judge [S1]
Past dean of the Washington State Judicial College, which trains judges statewide [S1]
Served on statewide civil-rules and pattern-jury-instruction committees [S1]
